CustomField.description: Developer name of the email template sent to an executive's contact when the CP Manager approves the executive. An executive works under its channel head's access and has no Partner Type or temporary access dates of its own, so this template shows none. Blank: no access email for executives (the site welcome email still goes out).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Developer name of the email template sent when an executive is approved. Blank: none.
CustomField.label: Executive Access Email Template
